step-1.text: Stand one side panel on its edge, holes facing in. Screw in two cam pins by hand, then tap in two dowels.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 2 cam pins and 2 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Slide the bottom panel onto the pins at the low end. Two cam locks go in, arrow toward the pin, then a firm clockwise turn.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 bottom panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: Pins and dowels go into the ends of the panels on this side too. Lower the second side onto all of them at once, then lock the last two cam locks.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 2 cam pins, 2 wood dowels and 2 cam locks.

step-4.text: Tap four dowels into the top edges of the sides. Set the top panel on, good side up, then lock it from inside with four cam locks.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 top panel, 4 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-5.text: Tap four dowels into the ends of the plinth board and press it in under the bottom panel, at the front.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 plinth and 4 wood dowels.

step-6.text: Tip the frame onto its front, on a rug or the flattened box so nothing gets scratched.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-7.text: Lay the back panel on, smooth side facing in. Line it up with one corner and nail it along the edges, about every twenty centimeters. If the corners line up, the frame is square.

step-8.text: Stand it back up on its feet. Nice, the box is done.

count-8.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-9.text: Good news: the drawer tracks come already fitted inside the frame on this one, two pairs. Check each one is tight and level, and that nothing got bent in the box.

step-10.text: First drawer. Lay the drawer front face down on something soft. Tap in four dowels, then press both drawer sides onto them, grooves facing in.

count-10.text: This step uses 1 drawer front, 2 drawer sides and 4 wood dowels.

step-11.text: The drawer bottom slides into the grooves from the back. Shiny side up. Push it home against the front.

step-12.text: Close the drawer with its back panel, then drive four screws through the back into the sides. Snug, not cranked.

count-12.text: This step uses 1 drawer back and 4 screws.

step-13.text: Now the second drawer, exactly the same way: front, sides, bottom, back. Then slide every drawer in onto its runners until it stops. The demo leaves drawer one pulled open so you can see inside. Take a break halfway if you need one.

count-13.text: This step uses 1 drawer front, 2 drawer sides, 1 drawer bottom, 1 drawer back, 4 wood dowels and 4 screws.

step-14.text: One knob per drawer. Each one gets a screw from the inside of the drawer front. Hand tight is plenty.

step-15.text: Fix the wall bracket to the back edge of the top, then into the wall with fixings made for your wall type. Tip-overs are real. Anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your CASABLANCA 2-drawer nightstand is built. Give it a proud little pat.
